body.message: Hi I am looking to rent a 1-bedroom, Dubai Creek Harbour or Creek Beach; approximately 60–80 sqm; furnished; 3-month tenancy; mid-January to mid-April 2027 initially; good-sized gym; outdoor pool that gets meaningful sun; creek/water view preferred; and, for Creek Beach, genuine beach access. In terms of Creek beach  Vida Residences Creek Beach as a preferred building.
